semiconductor_relevance: High — Cowin Semiconductor Materials specializes in high-purity semiconductor sputtering targets and related materials, which are critical for various semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Cowin Semiconductor Materials (Ningbo) Co., Ltd. focuses on the production of high-end semiconductor sputtering targets, leveraging a full-chain service model that includes metal purification and target manufacturing. The company serves multiple sectors, including chip manufacturing and thin-film solar energy, ensuring high material quality through advanced production processes.
capabilities: Wet Electrolytic Purification Technology for metal purification
Magnetic levitation melting technology for alloy production

regional_presence.China: The company is headquartered in Ningbo City, Zhejiang Province, and has a significant manufacturing presence there.
